data.title: 结城明日奈 · 骑士团露台的解剑深吻
data.description: 如火如荼的壮阔晚霞铺满整座艾恩葛朗特苍穹。亚丝娜解下了腰间佩戴细剑的皮带靠在一旁，罕见地褪去了副团长的严肃盔甲。她双手环绕在你的颈后，微微踮起脚尖，栗色长发在晚霞金风中如绸缎飞舞，双唇微启，主动迎向你的深情一吻。
data.location: 大圣堂前俯瞰云海的高台护栏边
data.action: 解下配剑放在身侧，双手环住你的脖颈踮起脚尖，闭眼倾身与你拥吻，晚霞染金战袍与发丝
data.lighting: 瑰丽磅礴的金色夕阳与漫天绯红晚霞，逆光勾勒金红边缘光
data.promptProse: On the castle terrace, Asuna rises onto her toes in her white tunic with red trim, her long chestnut hair blown out behind her. She closes her eyes and draws the taller black-haired swordsman close with both arms around his neck. His black coat frames his profile as he leans into the kiss. Her rapier and belt rest at the stone balustrade.
data.animaCaption: Asuna in white and red rises on her toes to kiss the swordsman in a black coat. Her long chestnut hair blows behind her while his cropped black hair falls over his brow.
